standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: Stored yellow cable loops now read as continuous smooth winding, but the upper free lead still terminates beside the reel rather than entering it.

rear.note: Rear mount, reel cheeks and winding remain coherent and within the original wall-mounted envelope.

detail.note: The lead bend is improved, but the cropped open upper endpoint visibly floats beside the rim; connect it to an evidenced winding or guide before approval.

underside.note: The outlet end is seated and the winding is continuous; the upper lead end remains visibly disconnected below the metal guide.

clay.note: The reel silhouette and rounded cord bends improve the source, while the remaining disconnected upper endpoint needs a narrow contact correction.

front.note: Rounded overhead hose corners and the layered cyclone, bucket and filter assembly read clearly at application scale.

rear.note: The rear hose is seated into the extractor cap and preserves the trolley and filter construction without visible floating endpoints.

detail.note: The annular inlet lip is readable and the bucket clips and fine pleated filter stay distinct; the molded cyclone body remains intentionally simplified.

underside.note: The open inlet bore is visible from below, and the bucket, filter feet and small trolley casters remain supported.

clay.note: The clay silhouette confirms continuous softened hose bends and the source cyclone/filter proportions without a new exposed cap across the inlet.

front.note: Smooth stored cable loops and the connected holster lead make the compact wall charger read as an assembled device.

rear.note: Rear cable arcs remain continuous and the original mounting enclosure is intact; cable storage stays stylized at this catalog scale.

detail.note: The former loose cable ends now meet the stored loops, with rounded transitions into the case and connector holster.

underside.note: The underside view shows seated case and holster connections with no dangling disconnected short tail.

clay.note: The clay view confirms clean closed winding contours and improved lead contact while retaining the original charger silhouette.

front.note: The upper casing now has a continuous curved crown and the toothed blade, fences and sliding rails remain legible.

rear.note: Rear motor, rails, casing and adjustable work supports retain the original mechanical assembly and clear separation.

detail.note: The gold semicircular casing is visibly smoother without erasing the saw teeth, handle, trigger or clamp details.

underside.note: The underside retains a closed supported base and coherent casing thickness; the catalog model does not claim internal working mechanics.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the improved semicircular guard outline while preserving the layered blade, fences, rails and clamp construction.
